about_the_game:
⚙️ Gameplay

Move side-to-side through the ship’s corridors and unleash automatic fire against relentless waves of four-legged robot enemies.
Each wave grows stronger and larger, up to 200 enemies at once, testing your reflexes, positioning, and weapon choices.

💥 Progression & Rewards

Every destroyed enemy has a chance to drop a wooden crate containing one of three treasure chests:

  • 🟩 Ammo Chests – Restore ammo and expand weapon capacity (Small, Medium, Large).

  • ❤️ Life Chests – Replenish lives and improve survival (Small, Medium, Large).

  • 🔫 Weapon Chests – Unlock new weapons or upgrade existing ones through four rarity tiers: Regular, Silver, Purple, and Golden.

There are 6 unique weapons, each with distinct stats and upgrade paths.
Survive, collect, and upgrade to push further into the uprising.

🧠 Enemies & Waves

  • Soldiers – Common attackers, fast and numerous.

  • Elites – Tougher units with higher damage.

  • Bosses – Massive threats that demand everything you’ve got.

Each enemy defeated earns score points but any that breach your barrier will cost you lives and score.
Complete waves to finish a run and earn gold based on your unused chests. Gold can be spent to buy new chests for your next attempts.

🌍 Compete Globally

Your performance feeds into global leaderboards:

  • Solo – Daily, Weekly, and Monthly rankings.

  • Alliances – Team up with friends, form alliances, and compete for the top of the group leaderboards.

Earn glory, gold, and bragging rights as you climb through the ranks of the resistance.

🔫 Key Features

  • 3D third-person shooter with side-to-side movement.

  • Auto-shooting, skill-based movement and positioning.

  • Endless enemy waves up to 200 units per round.

  • Weapon and chest progression system.

  • Global and Alliance leaderboards with daily/weekly/monthly resets.

  • Fast sessions and high replayability.

short_description: AI Uprising is a fast-paced 3D third-person shooter inside a futuristic spaceship under siege by waves of rogue AI machines. You are humanity’s last line of defense, armed, outnumbered, and standing between charging mechanical AIs and the fragile energy barrier protecting what’s left of your crew.
